I have coauthored, with Jorge Ufano, this short note in the Spanish journal El País where we briefly discuss the use of computer programs to support trading.

In July 2013 I gave a talk where I presented my personal view about the skills complementing University education.

In November 2016 I gave a talk in the CMU Loyola where I gave an introduction to the mathematical aspects of NLHE. I gave similar talks in the CMU Teresa de Jesús (February 2017) and in the CMU Diego de Covarrubias (March 2017).
